title: The Household Code
lead: Lists of duties for wives and husbands, children and parents, slaves and masters, found in Colossians 3:18-4:1, Ephesians 5:21-6:9, 1 Peter 2:18-3:7 and Titus 2:1-10. The form was known from Greek and Roman writers, and the New Testament versions change it in several ways.
